req.title: Basic-auth accepts correct credentials
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> with HTTP 200 and an authenticated=true JSON body when the supplied Basic credentials match.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the endpoint should authenticate using Basic Auth and return a 200 status with a specific JSON body when credentials are correct. Tests are designed to cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd with correct Basic Auth credentials
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd2Q='})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {"authenticated": True, "user": "user"}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_incorrect_credentials
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd with incorrect Basic Auth credentials
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic d3Jvbmd1c2VyOnBhc3N3ZA=='})
assert response.status_code == 401

tests.name: test_basic_auth_boundary_case_empty_user
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth//passwd with empty user and correct password
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth//passwd', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic OnBhc3N3ZA=='})
assert response.status_code == 401
